P1.16.text: Universal Health Services, Inc. Through its subsidiaries, the company operates 30 Acute Care hospitals, more than 380 Behavioral Health inpatient facilities, 35 freestanding emergency departments and multiple outpatient facilities and ambulatory care centers in 40 states in the U.S., Washington, D.C., Puerto Rico, Ireland and the United Kingdom. UHS Inc. subsidiary Talkspace has virtual behavioral health services throughout the United States and Puerto Rico. Prominence Health offers health plans and provider support, and Independence Physician Management develops and manages physician services and urgent care centers.

P1.2.text: We offer personalized mental health care through in-person and online therapy or psychiatry. Our licensed therapists, psychologists, and psychiatrists tailor care plans to your unique needs—and we accept most major insurance.

P1.4.text: Get the Mental Health Help You Need, the Way You Need It

P1.33.text: I have been a patient at LifeStance for about a year now and have only positive things to say about the care I have received.

P1.34.text: At LifeStance supported practices, there’s no one-size-fits-all approach to mental health. We tailor our care plans to fit each person’s unique needs. Our supported clinicians include psychiatrists, psychologists, and licensed therapists who are ready to support you. LifeStance supported practices offer both in-person and telehealth appointments, so you get the care you need in the format that serves you best. We also accept major insurance plans, allowing you to get the most from your personalized care plan.

P1.35.text: Get help for your specific condition

P1.36.text: Find the right clinician match for you

P1.37.text: Book an in-person or online appointment

P1.38.text: Our supported clinicians help people living with a variety of mental health conditions.

P1.39.text: Depression, bipolar disorders, or seasonal affective disorder can affect a person’s mood in a way that negatively impacts your life. Learning more about these mood disorders can help.

P1.40.text: Generalized anxiety disorder is a mental health condition characterized by a chronic and sustained worry that is intense enough to interrupt daily life.

P1.41.text: These conditions often require specialized care. We can help people cope with conditions such as avoidant, borderline, and obsessive-compulsive personality disorders.

P1.42.text: Conditions like ADHD, autism spectrum disorder, and oppositional defiant disorder can impact many parts of a person’s mental health. Learn how professionals can help.

P1.44.text: Our expansive network of licensed clinicians offers a wide variety of services.

P1.45.text: We provide mental health services when and where you need it.

P2.2.text: When you refer someone to LifeStance Health, you gain a collaborative team. We are your partners in caring for your patients. We keep you informed of your patient’s treatment plan.

P2.3.text: Healthcare Professionals and LifeStance Improve Lives Together

P2.4.text: Empowering Patient Care with LifeStance Health Support

P2.5.text: Every day, healthcare professionals see patients needing mental health treatment. As a trusted member of their care team, they look to you to provide guidance on their path to well-being. LifeStance Health’s clinicians treat a broad range of conditions and are in-network with more than 240 insurance plans. In most states, patients can be scheduled for therapy and/or psychiatry services in less than one week.
